question: Within the five exact rank-16 source interfaces, do canonical shared-mean and task-contrast weight directions define stable, causally distinct temporal/is-was source groups?
novelty_search: Prior rank-46 work typed downstream response modes, and the rank-16 compiler mapped the five source interfaces exactly into native Down weights. No receipt canonically splits those compiled source maps into shared versus task-contrast groups and executes the resulting physical weight patches in the complete model.
fit_and_identification: For each MLP0/1/2/3/6, form A=Down^T Q in R^(4608x16), then Z_task=delta_hidden_task A. Fit temporal and is/was rank-4 right singular spaces. Use their CS canonical pairs to define physical shared-mean and task-contrast blocks. Repeat on even/odd row halves before fitting the frozen all-row blocks.
physical_patch: For coordinate block B, install delta_y=(delta_hidden A B)(Q B)^T at each source MLP with the frozen gain 1.15. This is invariant to an orthogonal change of rank-16 interface gauge.
evaluation: Execute every arm in the complete model on the transferred temporal-v13/is-was-v12 target and matched-control families. Score signed downstream response, behavior, row-level KL/flips, exact block closure, spectral gaps, and even/odd projector stability.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_closure_finitene: All authorities match; full-rank16 replays its parent within 1e-5; union plus orthogonal complement closes within 1e-6; all metrics are finite; observed forwards <=48.
predictions.pred_b_task_pair_blocks_are_crossfit_sta: At least four of five sites have even/odd minimum canonical cosine >=.70 for both the shared-mean and task-contrast blocks.
predictions.pred_c_own_task_beats_cross_task: Own-task behavior signed projection exceeds cross-task by >=.10 for both tasks.
predictions.pred_d_mean_plus_contrast_is_functional_: The union passes the existing response/behavior functional bars and differs from full-rank16 by <=.03 on each response signed projection and behavior signed projection.
predictions.pred_e_union_complement_is_insufficient: The orthogonal complement has absolute response and behavior signed projection <=.50 for both tasks.
predictions.pred_f_weight_grouping_adds_no_parent_co: Union control flips are a subset of full-parent flips, median KL <= full+.002, and each task margin-RMS fraction <= full+.02.

terminal_policy.functional_unstable_task_blocks: A and D pass but B fails.
terminal_policy.shared_source_group_only: A, B, and D pass but task ownership C fails.

next_if_positive: Run full native-site singleton patches followed by greedy composition, licensed by the prior five-site higher-order energy .00138.
next_if_negative: Retain only crossfit-stable degenerate blocks and test downstream-reader-defined generalized eigenmodes rather than rotating another activation SVD.
